sources.claim: ENISA summarizes reporting that large sections of Duqu code are similar to Stuxnet code.
Kaspersky describes Duqu as based on the Tilded platform on which Stuxnet was developed.

curator_note: Modeled as code sharing rather than direct lineage because public reporting supports common/source-code access but not a simple descendant claim.
confidence_reason: ENISA summarizes Duqu/Stuxnet code similarity, and Kaspersky provides additional platform-level evidence tying Duqu and Stuxnet to the Tilded platform.
